new_facts_from_search: 2026-01: Devli bought 100 Leyland Dr, Leonia (37,000 SF, 24 ft clear, 4 docks, 2 drive-ins; Aboudi Realty brokered; Provident Bank financed; price undisclosed) - the pack's undated Leonia row is a 2026 deal, not 2019-2024 (https://re-nj.com/devli-real-estate-adds-37000-sq-ft-industrial-building-in-leonia/ ; https://nyrej.com/devli-real-estate-acquires-37000-sf-industrial-at-100-leyland-dr-in-leonia-nj)

2026-04/06: Devli bought 116-118 Route 17 N, Upper Saddle River, 67,000 SF three-building flex industrial/retail on 6.3 ac with 19 drive-ins and IOS potential; price undisclosed (https://re-nj.com/devli-acquires-67000-sq-ft-industrial-retail-portfolio-on-route-17-in-upper-saddle-river/ ; https://rebusinessonline.com/devli-real-estate-buys-67000-sf-industrial-flex-building-in-upper-saddle-river-new-jersey/)

Stated 2026 strategy quote from principal Christopher Devli: the Upper Saddle River buy 'advances our strategy of pursuing infill industrial and flex assets in supply-constrained Northeast submarkets' (https://nyrej.com/devli-real-estate-acquires-67000-sf-flex-industrial-property-on-rte-17-in-upper-saddle-river)

Carlstadt 4-acre assemblage (125 & 335 Paterson Plank Rd, 111 Twentieth St) dates to approx. 2023-06; three undisclosed sellers; CBRE (D'Amato, Babikian) and Team Resources (Rosenberg, Sholom) brokered; Mark Devli quoted as CIO, confirming the pack's 'unverifiable' title (https://re-nj.com/devli-completes-four-acre-assemblage-in-meadowlands-after-three-industrial-deals/)

Warren flex deal is pre-window: 150 Mt. Bethel Rd, Warren, 121,954 SF on 15.7 ac from The Hampshire Cos., approx. 2018-01, 88% leased, C&W brokered, price undisclosed - excluded from 2019-2024 table (https://www.connectcre.com/stories/devli-group-buys-hackettstown-commerce-park-in-warren-county-nj/ ; https://www.commercialsearch.com/news/devli-group-continues-acquisition-binge-in-nj/)
No 2025 NJ acquisition by Devli found on re-nj.com, roi-nj.com or njbiz.com (https://re-nj.com/tag/devli-real-estate/)
devli.com publishes no team/leadership page; names come only from press quotes (https://devli.com/company ; https://devli.com/acquisitions)

Correction: the 195,000 SF two-building New Brunswick industrial development (Joyce Kilmer Logistics Center) is a Faropoint + Deugen Development project, not Devli; a search summary had conflated it, so it was excluded as a Devli fact (https://re-nj.com/faropoint-deugen-eye-groundbreaking-for-195000-sq-ft-warehouse-project-in-new-brunswick/)
